semiconductor_relevance: High — NEOSEM provides specialized testing solutions for semiconductor memory and storage devices, which are critical in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: NEOSEM INC. specializes in developing high-volume automated test equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly focusing on solid-state drives (SSDs), custom flash arrays, and various semiconductor memory types. Their solutions enhance the efficiency and reliability of memory testing processes, collaborating closely with customers to meet specific testing requirements.
capabilities: High-volume automated test equipment for SSDs
Collaborative product development for testing solutions
